title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Senior Data Scientist

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Teramind is the leading platform for user behavior analytics, serving multiple use cases from insider risk mitigation to business process optimization. With our comprehensive suite of solutions, organizations gain unprecedented visibility into user activities while enhancing security, optimizing productivity, and ensuring compliance. Trusted by Fortune 500 companies and businesses of all sizes across industries, our innovative platform helps organizations protect sensitive data, maximize workforce performance, and create safer, more efficient digital workplaces. Through real-time monitoring and advanced analytics, we enable businesses to safeguard their most sensitive information while optimizing employee productivity in both in-office and remote work environments.

Our Core Values

At Teramind, our values drive everything we do. We embrace innovation as a fundamental principle, constantly pushing boundaries to improve our products, streamline processes, and enhance customer experiences. We foster resourcefulness by empowering our team members with the autonomy and confidence to solve problems independently while providing collaborative support when needed. As a globally inclusive organization, we celebrate diversity and create an adaptable work culture where respect and collaboration thrive across our international teams. Above all, we are committed to excellence, delivering the highest quality in every aspect of our work and consistently exceeding expectations in service to our clients and each other.

About The Role

Teramind is on a mission to reinvent how organizations understand work. With millions of behavioral signals flowing through our platform, we're unlocking a new era of intelligent workforce analytics - from predictive insights to behavior modeling and ML-powered decision-making. We're building a brand-new data science organization to make this vision real. And we're hiring a Senior Data Scientist who wants to build the models, pipelines, and intelligent systems that power the future of analytics at Teramind. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical work, rapid experimentation, and real product impact - this is your role.

What You’ll Do
  • Design and implement ML models for behavior prediction, anomaly detection, and risk scoring
  • Develop and fine-tune transformer-based models
  • Optimize models for production deployment—balancing accuracy, latency, and resource efficiency
  • Build end-to-end pipelines from raw behavioral signals to production-ready features
  • Partner with product and engineering to translate business problems into data science solutions
  • Run rigorous experiments—A/B tests, causal inference, statistical validation—to measure real impact
  • Prototype rapidly, iterate based on customer feedback, and ship models that scale
  • Contribute to the technical foundations and best practices of a growing DS function
What You Bring
  • Deep hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, and ML framework (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, XGBoost)
  • 5+ years of experience shipping ML models to production with measurable product or business impact
  • Strong fundamentals in statistics, causal inference, and experimental design
  • Experience with transformer architectures
  • Familiarity with model optimization for production constraints
  • Comfort working in ambiguity—scoping problems, finding data, and driving to solutions independently
  • Experience with large-scale data processing (Spark, BigQuery, or similar) is a plus
  • Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

This is a remote job. Work from anywhere! We’ve been thriving as a fully-remote team since 2014. To us, remote work means flexibility and having truly diverse, global teams.

Additionally:
  • Collaboration with a forward-thinking team where new ideas come to life, experience is valued, and talent is incubated.
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Ongoing training and development opportunities
About our recruitment process

We don’t expect a perfect fit for every requirement we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself contributing to the team, we want to hear your story. You can expect up to 3 interviews. In some scenarios, we’re able to streamline the process to have minimal rounds. Director-level roles and above should expect a more thorough process, with multiple rounds of interviews.

All roles require reference and background checks

Teramind is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, age, religion, color, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Not Applicable

title: Operations Director
description:
At Papel Holdings, we're not just another Fintech company.

We're on a mission to revolutionize the financial landscape.

From innovative banking solutions to cutting-edge digital asset products, we're transforming how people interact with money.

Careers at Papel suit those who want to have an impact, who are comfortable getting uncomfortable, willing to take risks and win big.

We are brave, laser-focused and have high aptitude, with a little playfulness for good measure.

If you're someone who thrives on high accountability, possesses a start-up spirit, and flair for industry‑savvy solutions, you'll fit right in. If this resonates with you, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact and be part of something that's changing how we interact with money and wealth.

POSITION OBJECTIVE

We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Operations Director to establish, lead, and scale operational functions in São Paulo for a newly licensed Electronic Money Institute (EMI).

This is a critical leadership role responsible for ensuring the efficiency, compliance, and excellence of all operational processes, with a specific focus on delivering business setup in line with Banco Central Do Brasil requirements.

The ideal candidate is a hands‑on leader with deep expertise in both fintech operations and the specific regulatory landscape of the Brazilian financial sector (BACEN and CVM).

You will be responsible for translating the regulatory approval into a fully operational, compliance‑and commercially successful business.

You will build the team, define strategy, establish processes, and launch our services to the market.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  1. Strategic Operations & Efficiency

    Serving as the key operational leader embedding EMI regulatory standards into operational processes.

    Ensuring strict adherence to regulations set by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN).

    Architect and implement the end‑to‑end operational framework to establish and scale the company's presence in the Brazilian market, from initial setup through to full regulatory and commercial readiness.

    Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process efficiency, reduce operational costs, and improve the overall customer experience.

    Design the internal organizational structure, define roles, and create a company culture grounded in compliance, innovation and customer centricity.

    Define and institutionalize performance metrics (KPIs & SLAs) across all operations ensuring execution discipline, accountability, and measurable impact on business outcomes.

  2. Regulatory Compliance & EMI Process Leadership

    Serving as the key operational leader embedding EMI regulatory standards into operational processes.

    Ensuring strict adherence to regulations set by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN).

    Responsible for establishing an independent Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit Function in accordance with BCB regulations.

    Ensure all senior management in the company acts in the best interest of the company and that senior management is approved by the regulator before assuming responsibility for the role.

    AML / KYC Operations: Overseeing enhanced Anti‑Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures to meet regulatory standards.

    Act as the primary operational liaison with regulatory bodies and internal compliance/legal teams during audits and submissions.

    Ensure timely and accurate regulatory reporting related to payment flows and reserves.

  3. Team Leadership & Development

    Lead, mentor, and grow a high‑performing operations team across various functions.

    Foster a culture of compliance, attention to detail, and operational excellence.

    Manage cross‑functional collaboration, particularly between Operations, Product, Engineering, and Finance.

    Act as the primary representative of the company to the Board of Directors, shareholders, and regulatory bodies.

  4. Vendor & Risk Management

    Manage critical vendor relationships, including partners for payment rails, banking services, and technology providers.

    Develop robust operational risk frameworks, maintaining and managing risk registers, conducting incident reviews and ensuring sufficient documentation.

REQUIREMENTS
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership role within the Fintech or Financial Services industry.
  • Mandatory experience working with BACEN regulations and a deep understanding of the operational requirements for an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) in Brazil.
  • Proven track record of scaling operations in a high‑growth environment.
  • Strong analytical and data‑driven decision‑making skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Fluency in both Portuguese and English is required.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • A Masters, MBA or relevant advanced degree in a related field.
BENEFITS
  • Competitive pay

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize mission‑critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to build a more equitable, inclusive world for employees, customers and communities.

Customer‑focused, growth mindset, open and inclusive. Demonstrated experience and proven leadership in SAP S/4HANA transformation or conversion programs.

  • Mastery of SAP migration tools and frameworks: consistency checks, reconciliation reports.

Diversity is more than appearance; it’s about how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences, and we create a workplace where everyone can bring their whole self and support an equitable culture.

State‑of‑the‑art resources and Fortune 100 clients provide opportunities to innovate and build new capabilities. Kyndryl offers benefits, learning programs, volunteering platforms, and invests heavily in your success.

About Specialty Capital Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.

Key Responsibilities Architecture & Technical Strategy
  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams
Mobile Application Architecture
  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities
Platform Development
  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes
Security & Compliance
  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures
Technical Leadership
  • Provide hands‑on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java / Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision‑making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master’s degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java / Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross‑platform mobile development frameworks
What We Offer
  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendanceCollaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

Descrição da vaga

Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP). Com mais de 100 anos de experiência, nossa missão é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, em residências, comércios, indústrias e agronegócio. Comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas de GLP por ano, representando aproximadamente 20% do mercado nacional.

Desenvolvemos projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável. A Supergasbras tem como objetivo, por meio da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de energia do Brasil para clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão são prioridades de negócios. Valorizamos a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e combate à discriminação racial.

Esta oportunidade também está publicada no portal global de vagas da SHV Energy e faz parte do nosso compromisso de atrair talentos que compartilham dos nossos valores, independentemente da localização.

Responsabilidades

Objetivo do cargo: Garantir que toda a frota da área esteja em condições de operar, com manutenções preventivas em dia, utilizando racional e eficientemente os recursos, assegurando condições seguras, econômicas e atendendo às necessidades da empresa.

  • Coordenar, acompanhar e orientar as atividades de gerenciamento da frota própria e de veículos locados, planejando e monitorando gastos, identificando oportunidades de economia e eficiência.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos de frota.
  • Garantir a execução das manutenções preventivas, mantendo todas as evidências documentadas.
  • Gerir e controlar diariamente a telemetria dos veículos, vida útil dos pneus, consumo médio de combustível e mapear os locais de abastecimento considerando custo e proximidade.
  • Suportar os processos de compras de peças, acessórios, pneus, diesel, materiais elétricos, máquinas e implementos, identificando e desenvolvendo fornecedores qualificados.
  • Gerir a documentação de transferência de veículos vendidos, garantindo a entrega correta após transferência.
  • Realizar movimentações de caminhões para manutenção, quando habilitado e treinado.
  • Visitar oficinas periodicamente para assegurar a qualidade dos serviços prestados.
  • Gerir e acompanhar despesas da área relacionadas a horas extras e custos de distribuição.
  • Manter a qualificação e desempenho da equipe, identificando necessidades de capacitação, desenvolvimento, promoção, transferência e reposição, e promovendo o feedback junto à área de Recursos Humanos.
Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo.
  • Domínio do Português.
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office, principalmente Excel (opcional).
  • Experiência na área de frota.

  • Celebração de aniversário: Folga no mês do aniversário.
  • Outros benefícios: Benefícios exclusivos.

Ao confirmar a candidatura, você está automaticamente aceitando nossa Política de Privacidade. Link:

Sobre a Supergasbras

Somos uma empresa que valoriza as pessoas e tudo que elas representam: a energia das ideias, a contribuição, a parceria e a colaboração. Construímos um ambiente de trabalho propício ao desenvolvimento humano e profissional, incentivando interação, participação ativa e crescimento.

Como parte do grupo SHV Energy, somos líderes na distribuição de GLP no Brasil e possuímos o mais moderno parque engarrafador da América Latina, com mais de 20 unidades industriais distribuídas pelo país. Nossos colaboradores, mais de 4 mil, levam energia para mais de 10 milhões de famílias brasileiras. Atendemos mais de 60 mil clientes empresariais em todo o território nacional.

description:
Job description Quem somos?

A Gabriel é uma startup de tecnologia, comprometida em resolver um dos maiores problemas do Brasil: a segurança das pessoas. Instalamos câmeras inteligentes e interconectadas, voltadas para a rua, a partir de condomínios, casas e comércios.

Nossa infraestrutura é capaz de entender dinâmicas criminais completas e proteger bairros inteiros. Com atuação em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro, a Gabriel tem a missão de construir a maior rede de câmeras do país e servir segurança em qualquer lugar a todos os nossos clientes.

O desafio é gigante. Por aqui, colocamos a mão na massa! Você terá oportunidades de aprendizado e enfrentará grandes desafios técnicos e de escala, junto com times multidisciplinares e altamente capacitados.

Vem conhecer mais sobre a Gabriel!

  • Acesse o nosso site:
  • Vem ver mais sobre quem somos:
  • Baixe o nosso app:
Main responsibilities

Sua missão é construir e liderar a operação de pré-vendas para gerar carteira de oportunidades qualificada que vira receita, com previsibilidade, velocidade de resposta e padrão de qualidade claro, em parceria com Marketing e Vendas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Traduzir a estratégia em prática diária : definir segmentos, regras de qualificação e roteiro de contatos e cadências; garantir que tudo seja executado e medido no CRM, com dados completos e atualizados;

  • Garantir velocidade de primeiro contato: organizar pessoas, roteamento e alertas para responder em minutos após a entrada do lead;
  • Cuidar do planejamento e da previsibilidade: metas por pessoa e por canal, cobertura de carteira, previsão semanal, correções de rota e remuneração variável do time;
  • Promover melhoria contínua: testar mensagens, canais e segmentos; analisar motivos de desqualificação; ajustar investimentos e processos;
  • Atrair e contratar talentos acima da média: desenhar perfil/competências, estruturar entrevistas e cases, realizar checagem de referências e manter pipeline ativo com parcerias e hunting;
  • Desenvolver um time acima da média: trilhas de aprendizagem, acompanhamento individual e rituais semanais para avaliar o funil, medir resultados e ajustar rotas.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Inquietude produtiva: Procuramos alguém inconformado(a) com o status quo, que melhora processos o tempo todo e questiona com dados, sempre com foco em resultado;
  • Gerar resultado com qualidade: priorizar segmentos e canais que mais convertem, garantindo critérios de qualificação consistentes;
  • Agilidade e disciplina: reduzir tempo de resposta e manter a execução do processo padrão;
  • Governança do funil e do CRM: dados confiáveis, etapas claras e passagem sem retrabalho;
  • Forte capacidade analítica: transformar indicadores em decisões e ajustes semanais;
  • Desenvolvimento do time: elevar habilidades, dar feedbacks objetivos e manter alto padrão de desempenho;
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua: testar, aprender e padronizar o que gera ganho real.
Requirements and skills

Qualificações:

  • Experiência liderando pré-vendas com time de qualificação e prospecção;
  • Domínio de funil comercial e métricas (conversões por etapa, produtividade por pessoa, tempo de resposta, custo por oportunidade);
  • Gestão de CRM e processos de passagem entre áreas (critérios e prazos definidos; controle de devoluções);
  • Capacidade de planejar capacidade e previsão (metas por pessoa/canal, cobertura de carteira, revisão semanal);
  • Habilidade de formar e desenvolver pessoas .

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com CRM Hubspot.

description:
Esta oportunidade de trabalho está aberta a qualquer pessoa independente de religião, cor, Pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero. O CIEDS é contrário a qualquer forma de discriminação e está comprometido com a inclusão, a diversidade e a igualdade de oportunidades. Se você acha que pode se beneficiar da nossa política de ação afirmativa, por favor informe na sua candidatura.

Acesse o edital na íntegra:

Resumo da Função

O Psicopedagogo exerce um papel essencial na promoção da inclusão escolar, atuando na construção de ambientes educacionais acolhedores e acessíveis a todos os alunos, independentemente de suas habilidades ou deficiências. Sua atuação é voltada tanto para o sucesso acadêmico quanto para o desenvolvimento emocional dos estudantes, contribuindo de forma significativa para uma educação mais inclusiva e equitativa. Esse profissional é responsável por identificar e intervir precocemente em dificuldades de aprendizagem, realizando avaliações abrangentes que permitem compreender as necessidades específicas de cada aluno. A partir desse diagnóstico, o psicopedagogo elabora estratégias e planos de intervenção personalizados, que podem incluir metodologias diferenciadas de ensino, uso de recursos específicos e acompanhamento individualizado. Dessa forma, o psicopedagogo atua como um elo entre os aspectos cognitivos, emocionais e pedagógicos do processo de aprendizagem, favorecendo o desenvolvimento integral dos alunos e fortalecendo o compromisso da escola com a educação inclusiva e de qualidade.

Atribuições
  • Realizar intervenção psicopedagógica, visando a solução dos problemas de aprendizagem;
  • Realizar diagnóstico e intervenção psicopedagógica, mediante a utilização de instrumentos e técnicas próprios de Psicopedagogia;
  • Utilizar métodos, técnicas e instrumentos psicopedagógicos que tenham por finalidade a pesquisa, a prevenção, a avaliação e a intervenção relacionadas com a aprendizagem;
  • Prestar consultoria e assessoria psicopedagógicas aos profissionais das unidades educacionais, objetivando a identificação, compreensão e a análise dos problemas no processo de aprendizagem;
  • Desenvolver atividades que ampliem a aprendizagem, por meio de jogos pedagógicos, da tecnologia, dentre outros;
  • Buscar a integração dos interesses, raciocínio e informações que fazem com que o aluno atue operativamente nos diferentes níveis de escolaridade;
  • Atuar para compreender os processos de desenvolvimento e das aprendizagens humanas, recorrendo a várias estratégias objetivando a resolução dos problemas que possam surgir;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento do processo educacional dos estudantes das escolas municipais em sala de aula e, se necessário, em contraturno, conforme as necessidades específicas de cada estudante da rede municipal de educação de Macaé;
  • Apoiar os docentes, os profissionais de apoio escolar à inclusão, a equipe gestora e demais profissionais da unidade escolar onde atuará em todas as ações pedagógicas voltadas para o estudante com deficiência;
  • Valorizar e estimular a autonomia do estudante;

What You’ll Do
  • Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for receivables and payouts in Brazil.

  • You have large experience in product management, ideally in tech-driven, agile organisations.

At SumUp, we’re on a mission to empower small businesses around the world with simple, affordable tools to help them start, run, and grow. More than 4 million merchants across 36 markets trust us as their financial partner — and we’re just getting started.

title: Head de BU (B2B)
description:
Overview

Como é trabalhar na Estoca?
O grande diferencial da Estoca é ser uma empresa de logística movida por tecnologia, o que se traduz em uma experiência mais rápida, operação com baixa fricção e maior visibilidade de tudo o que acontece para os e-commerces. Investida por fundadores da Loggi, Rappi, pela aceleradora Y Combinator e fundos de VC como Canary, Marathon e 8VC, a Estoca está em rápido crescimento. Em 2023 recebeu um investimento Series A liderado pela Astella. Em 2025, passou por uma nova rodada que posiciona a empresa com um valor de mercado próximo a R$ 500 milhões. Em 5 anos já entregou mais de 8 milhões de pedidos e atende grandes players do mercado. Nossos talentos impactam milhares de pedidos online processados por dia, simplificando a logística no Brasil. Buscamos construir um ambiente diverso, onde todos possam trazer o seu melhor, crescer profissional e pessoalmente, atuando com liberdade individual e autonomia. Estamos em busca de talentos que desejem impactar o crescimento da empresa, trabalhando de maneira colaborativa, trazendo conhecimento, questionando, sendo proativos e propondo soluções para os problemas existentes, construindo processos, implementando metodologias e deixando sua marca.

Responsibilities
  • Construir e implementar a estratégia da BU (visão de médio e longo prazo), assegurando execução, mas também inovação e oportunidades de crescimento. Traduzir a estratégia corporativa em um plano de negócios específico para a BU, definindo canais de distribuição, precificação e metas de crescimento.
  • Gerir e integrar funções críticas (vendas, marketing, produto, operações, P&L), a fim de garantir o resultado da BU. Responsabilidade total pela demonstração de resultados, monitoramento de margem, volume de negócios, custos operacionais e cumprimento do orçamento.
  • Ter domínio de finanças, alocação de capital e capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em ROI.
  • Lidar com trade-offs (crescimento vs margem, velocidade vs qualidade).
  • Colaborar com outras BUs e com a estratégia global da Estoca.
Requisitos
  • Formação em Engenharias, Economia, Administração, Tecnologia da Informação ou similares;
  • Pós-graduação em gestão ou finanças;
  • Experiência na implementação B2B (domínio operacional).
Desejável
  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência na indústria de logística

title: Engineering Director - Local Cards & Site Lead
description:
At PPRO, our mission is to simplify access to local payment methods and our vision is to enable the sale of goods and services to anyone in the world using their preferred way to pay. We empower partners such as Ant Group, PayPal and Stripe to access new markets, connect with more customers, and accelerate their growth.

Our strength lies in our diverse global team with 50+ nationalities and 10+ international locations‑all united around one goal – to deliver the best possible products and services to our partners and customers. While our company mission is to keep innovating global commerce, our internal mission is to #chooseaction, #beopen, #thinkcustomer, #gofurther and #wintogether.

Purpose

As Engineering Director for the Card Processing Domain, you will own the end‑to‑end technical strategy, architecture, and execution of PPRO’s local card‑rail portfolio while acting as the Engineering site lead for our São Paulo hub, including supporting teams outside of your domain. Your mission is to deliver a highly available, scheme‑compliant card processing enabling PSPs and merchants to sell globally.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Security, Risk & Compliance, and Commercial teams to keep transactions flowing smoothly, safely, and profitably. Blending big‑picture vision with hands‑on leadership, you’ll mentor engineers, uplift delivery practices, and cultivate a culture of ownership and innovation across ~40 colleagues in Brazil and beyond.

This is your chance to be the “CTO” of a domain inside PPRO building, learning, and shipping alongside talented, diverse teams on two continents.

Mission

Build a world‑class local card‑processing platform that maximises approval rates, minimises fraud and cost, and gives customers seamless access to local card schemes.

What You Will Be Doing
  • Define and Lead Engineering Strategy: Set technical direction for card rails, ensuring low latency, high resilience, and PCI‑DSS compliance.
  • Architect a future‑proof, cloud‑native platform, event‑driven services, and real‑time data pipelines.
  • Champion innovation across tokenisation, network‑tokens, intelligent retries, and SCA orchestration.
  • Deliver Engineering Excellence: Drive continuous delivery and “DevOps as a practice” where quality and testing is owned by every engineer.
  • Embed observability and automated compliance into the SDLC, shrinking incident MTTR and audit effort.
  • Lead and scale a High‑Performing Team.
  • Hire, coach, and retain top talent in São Paulo fostering autonomy, mastery, and purpose.
  • Act as mentor and sponsor, helping engineers grow and fulfil their potential.
  • As site lead, nurture local culture and community outreach while aligning with global standards.
  • Drive Operational Excellence: Cut auth latency, uplift issuer approvals, and optimise interchange costs through smart routing and data insights.
  • Own KPIs for uptime, latency, error rates, and cost per transaction; use metrics to guide continuous improvement.
  • Ensure Security & Compliance work hand‑in‑glove with Risk, Legal, and Partnerships to meet compliance, security and regulatory and scheme standards.
  • Implement automated risk controls and adaptive fraud‑mitigation pipelines.
  • Collaborate with Key Stakeholders: Together with your Product counterpart work with Commercial and Partnerships to unlock new markets and revenue streams.
  • Engage PSPs and strategic merchants to translate real‑world pain points into scalable technical solutions.
What We Are Looking For
  • Proven record leading engineering teams in an API‑first, high integrity environment and ideally in a payments environment, or similar regulated space.
  • Comfortable switching from strategic roadmap reviews to deep‑dive architecture and sessions when needed.
  • Mastery of cloud‑native, microservice architectures (Java, SpringBoot and AWS).
  • Strong grounding in CI/CD, security best practice, and observability.
  • Data‑driven mindset; you make trade‑offs explicit and optimise for impact.
  • Influence without authority, aligning your team and other functions on shared outcomes.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, clear, candid communicator across cultures.
Nice To Haves
  • Understanding of PSP economics, LatAm acquiring nuances, and global compliance drivers would be a plus.
  • Hands‑on experience with card scheme integrations, clearing & settlement, disputes, and PCI‑DSS would be advantageous.
What We Offer

Hybrid working – We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30‑day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.

Learning and Development – We offer a 3,000 BRL annual budget to support your professional growth. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on‑the‑job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.

Insurance – Because better safe than sorry – we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including life insurance, health insurance + dental plan and travel insurance.

Meal vouchers – BRL 54/ day – Enjoy a moment of conviviality and a good balanced meal thanks to your meal vouchers. You will also have the choice between meal allowance, supermarket voucher or both (splitting the total value in two).

Enhance Family Leave – We understand the importance of family – that’s why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.

Transportation voucher – We will cover your costs of commute!

Gym membership – PPRO helps contribute toward the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet.

New Value (Deals & Coupon Platform) – Get attractive discounts to restaurants, stores and events.

Mental Health Platform – We’ve teamed up with a top well‑being platform to provide one‑on‑one therapy, chat therapy, therapist‑led courses, guided meditations, and more.

SESC – private institution that makes available Education, Health, Culture and Recreational programs and events and provides Social Assistance to our employees and their dependents.

Pet‑friendly office – Because work is better with your paws by your side.

Our Principles
  • We get things done: We are courageous; we take ownership, make decisions and get things done.
  • We act with trust and integrity: We listen first and challenge respectfully. We seek out and leverage diverse perspectives. We welcome and offer honest and open feedback, always assuming positive intent.
  • We put the customer first: We are laser focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our customers. We put the customer at the heart of what we do.
  • We make things better: We boldly explore new ideas and have an unwavering commitment to continuous improvement.
  • We work as a team: We collaborate closely and value team success over individual achievement.

title: Executive Director - Morada Comum
description:
Overview

Executive Director

About Morada Comum

The vision of Morada Comum is of a Brazil where communities that today do not feel represented by the progressive climate movement and its institutions actively reconcile their personal interests and way of life with the protection of Brazil’s natural heritage, promoting the common good of the nation.

We achieve this by strengthening and incubating civic organizations and leaders that represent the audiences we work with. We believe that local civic associations are vital to building stable and lasting solutions for the country’s challenges. As part of the global network Our Common Home, Morada Comum shares the mission of building political consensus on key national priorities and promoting the tools that enable society to work together in developing solutions.

Position Overview

Now in its third year, Morada Comum has established strong foundations, making this an excellent moment to join as Executive Director. The next phase is about consolidating this progress and expanding its reach and influence.

Poised to become the leading voice of conservative environmentalism in Brazil, Morada Comum is uniquely positioned to connect communities, civic leaders, and partners around a shared vision for protecting the Brazil's natural heritage while promoting the common good.

Reporting to Our Common Home’s Global Management Team, you will oversee a senior team of seven, guide strategy, and build strong partnerships with civic organizations, government, and local communities. The role calls for a leader who can balance vision with execution—shaping long-term priorities while ensuring effective delivery through a capable team.

You will manage campaign and program budgets, measure results, and make the decisions needed to ensure accountability and impact. This position suits someone who enjoys building organizations, coaching senior staff, and achieving results through collaboration and partnership.

Core Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Advocacy

  • Define and manage the long-term strategic direction of Morada Comum in Brazil, aligned with OCH’s global mission.
  • Ensure initiatives reflect local community needs and priorities.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead a team of senior staff, fostering accountability, collaboration, and a high-performance, mission-driven culture.
  • Delegate program and operational execution while maintaining strategic oversight.

Partnerships & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain relationships with civic organizations, community leaders, media, and government partners.
  • Leverage partnerships to increase Morada Comum’s visibility and impact.

Fundraising & Resource Development

  • Lead strategy for securing financial sustainability through donors and partners.
  • Oversee major proposals and funding initiatives prepared by the team.

Program Oversight & Delivery

  • Ensure programs and initiatives are effectively executed and monitored.
  • Support the team in evaluating and adjusting strategies as needed.
  • Oversee organizational budgets, ensuring responsible financial management.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Occasional hands-on involvement in program delivery or civic engagement activities.
  • Daily administration, finance, and communications handled by senior staff or OCH’s global support team.
Candidate Profile

You may have led or helped build a nonprofit, civic association, policy institute, community initiative, or political campaign. Typical backgrounds might include:

  • Executive Director or Director of Programs or Public Policy in a national organization.
  • Chief of Staff, Senior Advisor, or Head of Strategy, Partnerships, or Institutional Development.
  • Campaign or Civic Initiative Director guiding engagement and consensus-building.
  • Community or Network Director strengthening participation and cooperation.

Key qualifications and experience:

  • Setting long-term strategic direction and priorities.
  • Leading senior teams to deliver complex programs.
  • Building partnerships with civic leaders, NGOs, government, or communities.
  • Designing or executing advocacy campaigns or public initiatives.
  • Strengthening community voice, representation, or leadership.
  • Strong fundraising and resource development skills.
  • Strategic and political acumen to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes.
  • Ability to mentor senior staff while maintaining oversight of impact.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and good English.

Additional competencies:

  • Clear and persuasive communication with diverse audiences.
  • Strong prioritization and delegation skills.
  • Confident and responsible financial stewardship.
What we offer
  • Competitive Salary
  • Chance to build an organisation

A Bry é uma empresa de tecnologia, especialista em soluções de identificação, formalização e registro digital de pessoas, processos e documentos . Com 24 anos de mercado, somos referência em assinatura digital, biometria, certificação e carimbo do tempo, atuando com foco em inovação, segurança e confiabilidade.

Aqui na Bry, somos movidos por inovação, aprendizado constante e colaboração. Buscamos pessoas com mentalidade de crescimento, que valorizem a tecnologia, tenham visão de futuro e queiram cocriar conosco a próxima geração de soluções digitais.

Estamos em busca de um Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) para integrar nosso time de operações. Você será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência dos nossos sistemas, implementando práticas de automação, monitoramento e melhoria contínua de nossa infraestrutura.

O Que Esperamos De Você
  • Formação em Ciências da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou Sistemas de Informação;
  • Desenvolver e manter sistemas altamente disponíveis e escaláveis;
  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para garantir a entrega contínua de software;
  • Automatizar processos operacionais para reduzir intervenções manuais;
  • Monitorar métricas de desempenho e implementar estratégias de mitigação de falhas;
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para melhorar a observabilidade e resiliência dos serviços;
  • Identificar e corrigir gargalos de desempenho e falhas em tempo real;
  • Documentar processos e melhores práticas para disseminação de conhecimento dentro da equipe;
  • Familiaridade com serviços de nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Você Irá Se Destacar Se Tiver
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • Entendimento de redes, protocolos e segurança de sistemas.
  • Experiência com Kubernetes e containers (Docker).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de scripting como Python, Bash ou Go.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi, etc.).
  • Certificações em cloud ou DevOps.
Benefícios que você terá fazendo parte do nosso #BryTecTeam
  • Auxílio Desenvolvimento (após o período de experiência)
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Horário flexível
  • Plano de carreira
  • Vale alimentação/refeição
  • Auxílio Home Office
  • GoGood + Conexa

Se você se identifica com a oportunidade, será ótimo ter você na Bry!

Nossa História

A C&A é uma das maiores redes de varejo de moda no mundo. De origem holandesa, foi fundada em 1841 pelos irmãos Clemens e August, cuja união das iniciais de seus nomes resultou na marca C&A.

Nessa trajetória de sucesso, em 1976 foi inaugurada a primeira loja no Brasil, no Shopping Ibirapuera, em São Paulo. Atualmente, a C&A está presente em todos os estados do território nacional com mais de 330 lojas.

Claro que, desde a sua primeira unidade, muita coisa mudou, mas a filosofia de trabalho continua a mesma: entendemos as pessoas, suas necessidades, evoluções, sua relação com a moda e as tendências, e traduzimos isso em uma experiência vibrante e completa. Esse é o nosso jeito de criar combinações para impulsionar e inspirar o pertencimento de cada pessoa.

Por aqui, acreditamos que nós podemos impactar positivamente as pessoas para que sejam o que desejam ser por meio da moda. Cada associada e associado traz consigo a alegria, a vibração e a energia para transformar o varejo e a moda no Brasil.

Somos muitos e únicos, cada um trabalhando para dar vida ao nosso propósito.

Além disso, há experiências que só a C&A pode oferecer: ambiente leve, informal e divertido; valores e compromissos inegociáveis para a sociedade; desenvolvimento profissional no varejo; e conexão com uma marca de renome e que entrega resultados consistentes.

Nós vestimos as mudanças! Esse é o nosso DNA!
